name: Marutham Thinner
description: Marutham Thinner Enamel Thinner is a high-quality solution designed for diluting enamel paints, cleaning brushes, and removing unwanted paint splashes effectively. Crafted to deliver exceptional performance, Marutham Thinner ensures that your enamel applications achieve a smooth, uniform finish, enhancing the longevity and appearance of your paint jobs.
applications: Achieving a smooth and uniform finish

name: Zebra Thinner
description: Zebra Thinner is a premium-quality paint thinner designed to deliver excellent performance and safety. Available in various can sizes of 4500ML, 2700ML, 1800ML, 900ML, and 450ML, Zebra Thinner is perfect for a range of applications, whether for professional or personal use. With its efficient formulation, Zebra Thinner effectively thins enamel, making it easier to apply and achieve a smooth, even finish. It is compatible with various paint types and works to clean brushes and surfaces, maintaining high-quality results without leaving residues.

safety_precautions.description: Always use Zebra Thinner in a well-ventilated area and follow recommended safety guidelines.

safety_precautions.title: Fire Safety
safety_precautions.description: Keep the product away from open flames, sparks, and direct heat sources because the product is flammable.
